edits.old: The owner fakes are stubbed from the owners' published documents and carry the placeholder where the source is silent (GAP-1131; ASM-2079; GAP-1133; ASM-2081).
edits.new:
The owner fakes are stubbed from the owners' published documents and carry the placeholder where the source is silent (GAP-1131; ASM-2079; GAP-1133; ASM-2081).

The customer, the contact point and the consent are set up in every Given and test-data line through the contact and consent fake of this section, which is the rwb-source-data contract fake, never through an ACE view or an extension table. Screen states the contract answers: empty is the 404 for an unknown notice; loading is the answer delayed beyond 2 s; error is the 503; no access is the 401 and the 403 of MSG-P4-002.

edits.old: the personal-data flag of a merge code is read from DF-REF-258 so the renderer can mask and the contract can test it.
edits.new:
the personal-data flag of a merge code is read from DF-REF-258 so the renderer can mask and the contract can test it. The session reference is an identifier only; whether it is personal data is read from Data Classification v5, and it is never a name, an address or a contact point.

**Reference data.** The lists the contract reads, LOV-NOTICE, LOV-LANG, LOV-CHANNEL and LOV-DELIVERY, and the template and merge rows, are read with the version in force through the reference-data contract of DP-06 and DP-07; no parameter value is fixed here (BR9).

edits.old: | Delivery event | `rwb.comms.NoticeDelivered.v1`: the notice, the case, the delivered date, the callback date, the delivery status and the channel; key caseId (EV-15) |
edits.new: | Delivery event | `rwb.comms.NoticeDelivered.v1`: the notice, the case, the delivered date, the callback date, the delivery status and the channel; key caseId (EV-15); the element of RWB-P6-E1055-CON with `channel` added additively, published on the first delivery of a notice and never by a later view (BR11) |

edits.old: | TC-P6-E4035-CON-06 | AC6 | Contract | The nine sub-tables with their owners, the naming baseline and the absence tests for a table of another owner, a cross-schema read and the old base |
edits.new:
| TC-P6-E4035-CON-06 | AC6 | Contract | The nine sub-tables with their owners, the naming baseline and the absence tests for a table of another owner, a cross-schema read and the old base |
| TC-P6-E4035-CON-07 | AC6 | Contract | Boundary of 12.7: each owned table and each consumed table named once at its edge; a table name outside 12.7 read or declared fails the build |
